summary: Sub-Inspector in Delhi Police & CAPFs (CPO) 2026 – Paper 1
intro: The Staff Selection Commission (SSC) is releasing the SSC CPO Admit Card 2026 batch-wise for the Sub-Inspector in Delhi Police and Central Armed Police Forces (CPO) Paper 1 Computer Based Test. The exam is being held in shifts and runs till 28 November 2026.

Admit cards are released a few days before each candidate's exam date (for example, the card for the 24 November shift was released on 21 November). Candidates should download it from the official SSC website using their registration details.
table: SSC CPO (SI in Delhi Police & CAPFs) 2026 – Paper 1

ol: Visit the official website ssc.gov.in and log in.
Open the Admit Card section and select CPO 2026 Paper 1.
Enter your Registration Number / Roll Number and Date of Birth.
Download the admit card and take a clear printout.
Carry the printout with a valid original photo ID to the exam centre.

ul: Candidate name, roll number and photograph
Exam date, shift and reporting time
Important instructions for the exam day

faq: When will the SSC CPO Admit Card 2026 be released?
It is released batch-wise, a few days before each candidate's exam shift.
Till when is the SSC CPO Paper 1 exam?
The Paper 1 CBT is scheduled till 28 November 2026.
Where can I download the SSC CPO hall ticket?
From the official website ssc.gov.in after logging in.
What should I carry to the exam centre?
A printout of the admit card and a valid original photo ID proof.
final: Download your SSC CPO Admit Card 2026 as soon as it is available for your shift and check all details carefully.
Follow @employmentjunction.in on Instagram for instant exam updates.
